verdict.rationale: Signifyd ships SDKs and a device-profiling script, so a telemetry or usage-tracking opt-out is a fair question for this product. The evidence pack documents no such opt-out. The sensitive-data protection layer only rejects unwanted sensitive data in API requests, which is an adjacent control rather than a way to opt out of telemetry.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
